name: Tampa Maids Cleaning
tagline: Get your time back. We'll handle the rest.
positioning: For Tampa Bay and Sarasota homeowners and small businesses who want their time back without worrying about who they're letting in the door, Tampa Maids Cleaning is the bonded, locally-owned cleaning team that shows up on time, uses safer products, and leaves your space noticeably better — every single visit.
mission: To deliver dependable, eco-conscious cleaning that gives Tampa Bay and Sarasota families and businesses back their time, with a team that treats every property as if it were their own.
description: Residential and commercial cleaning across Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater and Sarasota. Bonded, insured, background-checked W-2 team. Safer Choice products. Flat upfront pricing.

booking.cancellation_policy: Residential service is month-to-month. Reschedule or cancel free up to 48 hours before your visit; inside 48 hours a cancellation fee applies to cover the crew's reserved time. Commercial contracts run 12 months with a 60-day out clause.
booking.first_clean_note: First visits are priced as a deep clean (a 35% premium) to bring the property to a maintainable baseline. Every visit after that is at your normal recurring rate.

pricing._note: ALL MONEY IN CENTS. 9500 = $95.00. Tiers and rates are taken directly from Section 5 of the business plan.
pricing.tax_note: Florida exempts cleaning of residential dwellings (F.S. 212.05). Commercial cleaning is taxable at 6% state plus local surtax. Confirm with your CPA.

faq.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faq.a: No. Most of our clients give us a door code, lockbox or key, all logged in a chain-of-custody record. You'll get a text when the crew arrives, and before/after photos in your account when they finish.

By your home size tier and how often we visit — not by the hour. You see the exact total before you confirm and it does not change unless you ask us to do more. First visits are priced as a deep clean to bring the home to a maintainable baseline.

faq.q: Why is the first clean more expensive?
faq.a: A first visit is priced as a deep clean, about 35% above your recurring rate. It covers the built-up work a maintenance visit doesn't reach — baseboards, grout, inside appliances, vents. Every visit after that is at your normal recurring price.

faq.q: Do you bring your own supplies?
faq.a: Yes, at no extra charge. HEPA backpack vacuums, a color-coded microfiber system laundered between every job, and EPA Safer Choice certified concentrates. If you'd rather we use your products, leave them out and note it on your booking.

Fully. $1M/$2M general liability, a $25,000 janitorial bond, workers' compensation and commercial auto. Every technician is a W-2 employee who has passed a national background check and E-Verify before their first job.

faq.q: Will I get the same cleaners each visit?
faq.a: For recurring clients, yes. We assign a dedicated two-person team so they learn your home and your preferences. If someone is out, we brief the replacement with your notes and photos first.
Tell us within 24 hours and we re-clean it free. That's our rescue protocol and there are no questions asked. Our owner also personally walks through your first and fourth visits.
Residential service is month-to-month. Reschedule or cancel free up to 48 hours before your visit from the app or by phone. Inside 48 hours a fee applies because the crew's time is already reserved.
Residential clients are charged to a saved card on the day of service. Commercial accounts are invoiced net-15. We accept all major cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

faq.q: Do you handle vacation rental turnovers?
faq.a: It's one of our specialties. We run a 28-point turnover checklist with full linen re-set, consumable restocking, photo verification and a same-day SLA inside your check-out/check-in window, seven days a week in peak season.

Cleaning of residential dwellings is exempt from Florida sales tax under F.S. 212.05, so your home cleaning has no tax added. Commercial and non-dwelling cleaning is taxable and shows the tax line on your invoice.

We cover four markets: Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater and Sarasota, along with the communities around each — South Tampa, Westchase, Brandon, Riverview, Snell Isle, Pinellas Park, Gulfport, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island, Largo, Seminole, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, Siesta Key, Longboat Key and Lakewood Ranch. We're based in Tampa. A small drive-time surcharge applies to the farthest beach, eastern and Sarasota addresses. If you're just outside, call us — we can often still make it work.
If a storm closes the area we contact you to reschedule at no charge, and we prioritize getting your recurring slot back first. We also offer post-storm cleanup as a separate service.
